devices.name: Wand

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.4 Magical Devices

devices.text: A slender rod of bone or wood holding one spell of the first or second level, cast at its maker's level, until its 2d4+2 charges are spent. It is never recharged.

devices.name: Staff

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.4 Magical Devices

devices.text: A carved staff holding two or three spells that share 3d4 charges. Only a caster can draw on it, and it is never recharged.

devices.name: Rod of Light

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.4 Magical Devices

devices.text: Readied, it sheds a steady light underground that never burns out.

devices.name: Rod of Mending

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.4 Magical Devices

devices.text: Readied, it lets its bearer stabilize the Mortally Wounded with no check.

devices.name: Rod of Warding

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.4 Magical Devices

devices.text: Readied, it gives its bearer +1 to saves against spells.
